scope: No RRT/hybrid, probability-model redesign, fitting/grasp-planner/WorldModel redesign, GUI controls, additional controllers, force-controlled pushing, carried-object or intended-contact exemptions. Commit/push feature/motion-planning; do not merge main.

baseline_evidence.full_capture_qualification: Full worker input/state captures add disk/serialization latency and are excluded from availability/performance claims. Timings-only native cohorts are reported separately.

planned_changes: Exact bounded packet BVH traversal over unchanged robot meshes, ray selections, depth/pose tolerances and original intersection arithmetic; original traversal retained as fallback/reference.

RGB-D-only admission of already OCCUPIED, observed, unexpired sparse cells with existing temporal occupancy probability at least0.95, in addition to unchanged spatial support. GT/default extractor remains unchanged. No extra cells, padding, completion, UNKNOWN fill or occupancy-model change.
Experimental RGB-D-only local thin surface consolidation; adopt only after physical behavior and gap checks. No controller parameter changes.

matched_conditions.unchanged: Scene geometry, actual physical fixture definitions, camera extrinsics/intrinsics, targets, controller and feedback/tolerances remain the V2 definitions. All cases use the selected strategy for empty-environment setup; no hidden direct fallback.

matrix.execution: One fresh Isaac process per case, strictly sequential. No competing GPU/CPU profiling. All attempts retained, including setup refusals; no success-only selection.

source_comparison.baseline: Eight unchanged-source reactive timings-only attempts: four RGB-D scenarios at2Hz, the same four at2.5Hz.
source_comparison.candidate: Repeat the identical workloads/rates with both narrow production changes; report original acquisition age, queue/filter/integration/extraction/worker/publication/first-use and reused ages, counts and errors.
source_comparison.policy: No stale_after increase, timestamp rewriting, additional last-known-evidence policy, or collision-unaware fallback. Known failures/reset/closure remain explicit failure and hold.

geometry_gates.strict_source_cells: Exact residuals contain only eligible occupied cells. Completed patches may include only bounded explicitly counted UNKNOWN cells under the local support rules; no FREE/expired inclusion. Canonical occupancy must remain byte-identical.
geometry_gates.retention: Quantify observed physical endpoints, temporal evidence, support loss, candidate/selected physical cells, floor occupancy and budget omissions at matched stages. Expect settled strong post cells to survive instead of being discarded by radius-two support.
geometry_gates.ground_truth: Preserve V2 clear goals in usable GT scenes; preserve broad-wall timeout as a failure, not forced completion.
geometry_gates.unknown_traversal: At least one reactive empty-scene successful contact-free route with a majority of actual TCP samples classified UNKNOWN. Sparse point queries are not a swept-volume proof.

contact_assessment.strict_v2_success: Goal reached AND zero reported PhysX contact points AND positive independent cooked-hull clearance when an external object exists. Retain separately.
contact_assessment.proximity: Nonpenetrating zero-normal-impulse reports with positive independent clearance are contact-offset proximity, not demonstrated solid penetration.
contact_assessment.physical_contact: Report penetration distribution, normal point/pair impulses, observed duration, SDK COM-correct point speed, relative/normal speed and independent displacement speed. Do not infer pre-impact speed from post-solver spikes.
contact_assessment.force: Normal step-average force only when impulse and consecutive physics-step dt are verified; never divide by wall time. Tangential friction and calibrated peak force are not inferred.
contact_assessment.qualification: No validated universal harmless-contact force/depth threshold is available. Physical contacts stay ungraded with raw measurements; practical improvements use paired continuous reductions and goal behavior, not arbitrary binary low-severity PASS claims. No contact signal controls motion or implements pushing.

performance_gates.hot_path: No full-grid operation or worker wait on Kit; only prepared descriptors and bounded telemetry.
performance_gates.source: Actually applied evidence must remain below the original1s budget; refused stale input is not counted as stale application. Availability failures stay visible.
performance_gates.cadence: Report exact counts/windows; short motions permit phase-boundary quantization. Report bounded queues, replacement/rejection/error counts and resource growth.

regressions.preserve: No weakened assertions or removed baseline tests, no direct-strategy edits, no existing scene-profile/controller/SDK changes.

amendment_reason: The exact-cell candidate recovered source availability and removed contacts but static/thin routes blocked. Independent proxy audit found only true fixture hazards. Installed public Lula probe shows representation-dependent accumulation even for equal geometric union. Evaluate one bounded observed-surface consolidation candidate; preserve exact-cell failures.

bounded_surface_completion.eligible_support: Strong observed unexpired OCCUPIED cells with existing temporal probability>=0.95; at least two local observations within a voxel plane supported by at least three strong source cells globally.
bounded_surface_completion.geometry: One-original-voxel normal thickness, tangential span<=0.06m, no extrapolation beyond support bounds. Every added UNKNOWN cell lies within two Chebyshev voxels AND0.02m of strong observed support.
bounded_surface_completion.forbidden: No known FREE cell, no floor completion, no expired evidence, no large UNKNOWN-gap bridge, no overlapping completed geometry; all prior eligible OCCUPIED cells remain covered by a patch or exact residual before the existing64-proxy budget.
bounded_surface_completion.map: Canonical probabilities/states and UNKNOWN remain unchanged. Additional planning UNKNOWN volume/cell counts are explicit and bounded, not certified occupied space.
bounded_surface_completion.timestamps: A completed primitive expires at the oldest original contributing evidence TTL; added cells never gain new observation timestamps.
bounded_surface_completion.computation: Bounded candidate/anchor work; excess input remains exact residual. Ground-truth/default extraction keeps the previous representation.
bounded_surface_completion.ranking: Rank on actual observed coverage, not extra UNKNOWN volume, so interpolation cannot manufacture budget importance.
bounded_surface_completion.acceptance: Require independently checked gap/map/expiry invariants and measured practical goal improvement before adoption. Otherwise retain the failed trial and reject the completion change.
